mapper.select: SELECT FROM automation_coupon_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM automation_coupon_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM automation_coupon_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND batch_id>#{after} ORDER BY batch_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT batch_id FROM automation_coupon_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status IN ('RUNNING','REVOKING') AND available_at<=#{now} ORDER BY available_at,batch_id LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM automation_coupon_batch WHERE tenant_id>#{after} AND status IN ('RUNNING','REVOKING') AND available_at<=#{now} ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT 4
mapper.update: UPDATE automation_coupon_batch SET status=#{status},mode=#{mode},attempts=0,error_code=NULL,available_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{id} AND version=#{expected}

UPDATE automation_coupon_batch SET cursor_member=#{member},processed=processed+1,issued=issued+IF(#{issued},1,0),skipped=skipped+IF(#{issued},0,1),attempts=0,error_code=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'

UPDATE automation_coupon_batch SET revoke_cursor=#{member},revoked=revoked+IF(#{revoked},1,0),kept=kept+IF(#{revoked},0,1),attempts=0,error_code=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{id} AND status='REVOKING'

UPDATE automation_coupon_batch SET status=IF(attempts+1>=5,'ISOLATED',status),attempts=LEAST(5,attempts+1),error_code=#{code},available_at=#{next},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{id} AND status IN ('RUNNING','REVOKING')
mapper.select: SELECT next_eligible_at FROM automation_coupon_frequency WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO automation_coupon_frequency(tenant_id,member_id,next_eligible_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{member},#{next}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE next_eligible_at=GREATEST(next_eligible_at,#{next})
mapper.select: SELECT member_id,status,coupon_id,error_code,created_at FROM automation_coupon_recipient WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{id} AND member_id>#{after} ORDER BY member_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT member_id,status,coupon_id,error_code,created_at FROM automation_coupon_recipient WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{id} AND member_id>#{after} AND status='ISSUED' ORDER BY member_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE automation_coupon_recipient SET status=#{status},error_code=#{code} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{id} AND member_id=#{member} AND status='ISSUED'
